meta.note: Data for Step Mode explanations. Plain US English, short lines, \n for line breaks. factoryRules: first match wins; each regex runs on "DebitAccount|CreditAccount".

Allowance (kid's).name: A child's pocket money
Allowance (kid's).why:
Personal money for a child.
It never shows up in company books.

Pay Stub.name: A document
Pay Stub.why:
A paper showing one paycheck.
The books record Salaries Expense.

Receipt.name: A source document
Receipt.why:
Proof that a payment happened.
The books record the deal itself.

Budget.name: A plan
Budget.why:
A plan for future spending.
It is not a real transaction.

Invoice.name: A source document
Invoice.why:
A bill that asks for payment.
The books record the sale or purchase.

Grocery List.name: A shopping note
Grocery List.why:
A note of items to buy.
It is not a business record.

Piggy Bank.name: A container
Piggy Bank.why:
A box for saving coins.
Company money inside is Cash.

Wallet.name: A container
Wallet.why:
A holder for bills and cards.
The money inside is Cash.

Calculator.name: A tool
Calculator.why:
A tool for doing math.
Bought for work, it is Office Expense.

Credit Score.name: A rating
Credit Score.why:
A number about borrowing habits.
It is not an amount owed.

Price Tag.name: A label
Price Tag.why:
A label showing a price.
The books record the actual sale.

Coupon.name: A discount offer
Coupon.why:
A voucher for a lower price.
It is not a ledger account.

Gift Card.name: A prepaid card
Gift Card.why:
A card with stored value.
When sold, it is a liability until used.

Loyalty Card.name: A rewards card
Loyalty Card.why:
A card for shop rewards.
It is not a ledger account.

Bank Statement.name: A report
Bank Statement.why:
A list of bank activity.
Use it to check Cash, not as an account.

Checkbook.name: A tool
Checkbook.why:
A book of blank checks.
The money in the bank is Cash.

Tax Return.name: A filing
Tax Return.why:
A form sent to the government.
Tax owed is Income Taxes Payable.

Accountant.name: A person
Accountant.why:
A person who keeps or checks books.
People are not accounts.

Board Meeting.name: An event
Board Meeting.why:
A meeting of company leaders.
Meetings are not transactions.

Shareholder Meeting.name: An event
Shareholder Meeting.why:
A meeting of the owners.
Owner money is Common Stock.

Business Hours.name: A schedule
Business Hours.why:
When the shop is open.
It is not a money item.

Lunch Money.name: A personal habit
Lunch Money.why:
Personal money for a meal.
It is not a company account.

Gas Money.name: A personal habit
Gas Money.why:
Personal money for fuel.
Fuel for business trips is Travel Expense.

Bus Fare.name: A travel cost
Bus Fare.why:
A ride ticket cost.
Business trips go to Travel Expense.

Online Store.name: A sales channel
Online Store.why:
A place to sell online.
Sales made there are Sales Revenue.

Paycheck.name: A document
Paycheck.why:
A check for pay earned.
The company records Salaries or Wages Expense.

Tip Jar.name: A container
Tip Jar.why:
A jar for tips.
It is not a ledger account.

Business Card.name: A card
Business Card.why:
A card with contact info.
Printing it is an Office Expense.

Calendar.name: A schedule
Calendar.why:
A chart of dates.
It is not a ledger account.

Price Quote.name: An offer
Price Quote.why:
An estimate of cost.
No deal yet, so no entry.

Packing Slip.name: A source document
Packing Slip.why:
A list of items in a box.
It supports a sale or purchase.

Purchase Order.name: A request
Purchase Order.why:
A request to buy goods.
No entry until the goods arrive.

Stock Ticker.name: A display
Stock Ticker.why:
A feed of share prices.
It is not a ledger account.

Savings Goal.name: A target
Savings Goal.why:
An amount a person hopes to save.
A goal is not a real balance.

Rainy Day Fund.name: A personal habit
Rainy Day Fund.why:
Money set aside by a person.
Company cash is just Cash.

Garage Sale.name: A personal event
Garage Sale.why:
A home sale of used things.
It is not a business account.

Black Friday.name: A sales day
Black Friday.why:
A big shopping day.
Sales made then are Sales Revenue.

Sticky Note.name: A tool
Sticky Note.why:
A small paper reminder.
It is not a ledger account.

Job Offer.name: A promise
Job Offer.why:
A promise of a job.
No entry until work is done.

Wish List.name: A personal list
Wish List.why:
A list of things to want.
It is not a business record.

Prepaid Expense.rule: Cash was paid, but part of it covers next period
Prepaid Expense.how:
Booked as an expense? Move the unused part to Prepaid.
Booked as Prepaid? Move the used part to expense.
Prepaid Expense.je: Dr Prepaid Insurance / Cr Insurance Expense (or the reverse)

Unearned Revenue.rule: Cash was received, but the work is not done yet
Unearned Revenue.how:
The unearned part is a liability.
Revenue is earned only after the work.
Unearned Revenue.je: Dr Unearned Revenue / Cr Service Revenue

Accrued Revenue.rule: Revenue was earned, but no cash yet
Accrued Revenue.how:
The right to collect is an asset.
Record the revenue in this period.
Accrued Revenue.je: Dr Interest Receivable / Cr Interest Revenue

Accrued Expense.rule: A cost was used, but not yet paid
Accrued Expense.how:
The duty to pay is a liability.
Record the expense in this period.
Accrued Expense.je: Dr Interest Expense / Cr Interest Payable

Depreciation.rule: A long-lived asset wore out for another year
Depreciation.how:
The used-up cost is Depreciation Expense.
The contra account holds the total.
Depreciation.je: Dr Depreciation Expense / Cr Accumulated Depreciation—Equipment

Bad Debt.how:
Estimate the loss as Bad Debt Expense.
The allowance lowers receivables.
Bad Debt.je: Dr Bad Debt Expense / Cr Allowance for Doubtful Accounts

Supplies Used.rule: Some supplies on hand were used up
Supplies Used.how:
Count what is left at year-end.
The used part becomes expense.

Inventory Shrinkage.rule: The count of goods is lower than the records
Inventory Shrinkage.how:
Write off the missing goods.
The loss goes to Cost of Goods Sold.
Inventory Shrinkage.je: Dr Cost of Goods Sold / Cr Merchandise Inventory

Cash Over and Short.rule: The cash count does not match the records
Cash Over and Short.how:
A shortage is a debit.
An overage is a credit.
Cash Over and Short.je: Shortage: Dr Cash Over and Short / Cr Cash

Income Tax.rule: Tax on this year's profit must be recorded
Income Tax.how:
Expense it now.
What is not yet paid is a liability.
Income Tax.je: Dr Income Tax Expense / Cr Income Taxes Payable

Closing Entries.rule: The year ends and temporary accounts must reset
Closing Entries.how:
Close revenue and expenses to Income Summary.
Then close it and Dividends to Retained Earnings.
Closing Entries.je: Dr Sales Revenue / Cr Income Summary

factoryRules: ^(Interest Receivable|Rent Receivable)\||^Accounts Receivable\|(Service Revenue|Fees Earned|Commission Revenue)$
^(Cost of Goods Sold|Loss from Theft)\|Merchandise Inventory$

General Journal.use: Any entry with no special journal, in date order
General Journal.why: The first record of transactions that no special journal covers.

General Ledger.why: Holds one page per account and feeds the trial balance.

Accounts Receivable Subsidiary Ledger.why: Tracks each customer's balance; it must match Accounts Receivable.

Accounts Payable Subsidiary Ledger.why: Tracks each supplier's balance; it must match Accounts Payable.

Sales Journal.why: Records merchandise sold on account, in date order.

Purchases Journal.why: Records credit purchases in one place, in date order.

Cash Receipts Journal.why: Records every receipt of cash in one place.

Cash Payments Journal.why: Records every payment of cash in one place.

Petty Cash Record.use: Small payments from the petty cash fund
Petty Cash Record.why: Lists each small payment and the fund balance.

Inventory Subsidiary Ledger.use: Units and cost for each product
Inventory Subsidiary Ledger.why: The perpetual record of each item's units in, out, and on hand.

Plant Asset Subsidiary Ledger.use: Cost and depreciation of each long-lived asset
Plant Asset Subsidiary Ledger.why: Tracks each asset's cost, date, and depreciation.

Trial Balance.why: A list of ledger balances used to test the books.

Worksheet.why: A working paper that lines up balances and adjustments.

Bank Reconciliation.use: Matching the bank statement to the books
Bank Reconciliation.why: Explains differences between the bank balance and the Cash balance.

Payroll Register.use: Pay, withholdings, and net pay for each employee
Payroll Register.why: Summarizes gross pay, taxes withheld, and net pay for a pay period.
